notes.title: Chorizo Update - Patch note 1.0.8
notes.content:
Greetings Deathliverers!


We're continuing to update the Pizza Deathlivery demo, and we're taking on all the feedback you give us!

In summary:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627462/26a44dc48017083bdd89ad2b3a21ed1e1003d6e7.png"]


In detail:
Fix: "ghost object" in hand preventing to take other objects,

Fix grabbable objects position on level reload start,

Fix dead player not register as spectator and stuck on their ragdoll body,

Fix (Hopefully) random invisible players,

Fix: run animation when being freeze,

Fix: Balloon Head stuck in laughing animation even if player was delivered,

Improve performance,

Option menu modification - Brightness is inside "Graphics" option now,

Add sounds for door, chorizo & barricades

Add buildings (cinema, gas station, coffe shop)

Add a first floor in the emergency with an escape

Rework onboarding (tutorial)

Add interactable door and lockers

 Imminent Roadmap (not exhaustive):

Prevent interaction through walls and obstacles,

Fix camera messy behavior when in spectator mode and object blurriness when moving



This update marks a turning point, in the sense that we're going to return to adding content to the game and, above all, creating the whole progression system. This means that, depending on the bugs we receive, we'll be slowing down the update of this demo. 



We can't wait for you to try out the rest of the game!

See you soon!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest End, Patch Note & Roadmap !
notes.content:
Hello Deathliverers!


We've come to the end of Steam Next Fest, and what an explosive week it's been!  


Thanks so much for your feedback on the Pizza Deathlivery demo! 


Your help has been invaluable, especially on a game of this scale. We really want to make it as fun and engaging as possible! 



This week and next, we'll be continuing to update the demo regularly, to make it as clean and bug-free as possible. We'll then slow down on updates to continue developing the game, with the aim of: 
opening playtesting sessions during the summer (stay tuned !). 

Here you can see a summary of today's patch:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627462/951ea255a7a26380b4307f4044c92d1d6f365696.png"]


And in detail :
Rework the city's level design (faulty road, street lighting, etc.)

Add a basketball and basket to the emergency

Change the polaroids text

Change the car spawns (more spooky!)

Add street and avenue names to the pizzeria map

Change the city hall block

Prevent objects to have a wrong position on start (especially the door lever)

Prevent player pseudo to appear/disappear when in spec mode





As always, don't hesitate to send us your feedback, and give us your opinion on future developments!



See you soon!

notes.content:

notes.title: Performance Update - Demo
notes.content:
Hello Deathliverers!



A quick update to improve game performance (and fix a few bugs).

Working on optimization (set LOD in place + reduce enemies target checking to 2 per second instead of 1 per frame) : still work in progress, currently not as good as we expected

Fix: enemies target client players correctly,

Fix: egg don't spawn in emergency anymore,

Fix: floor layered correctly in emergency,

See you later!

notes.title: Let's keep improving and fixing the Demo
notes.content:
Hi Deahtliverers!


Once again, we've made a number of bug fixes and overall improvements to the demo.

Your feedback is essential, so don't hesitate to send it to us either via steam or our discord!



Our Discord: https://discord.gg/rMHY8E9C


Update summary:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627462/30bfa4f20e5e828a29163d9fbcce7e655ce602c1.png"]


And to go into more detail :
This time we tried to make monsters more menacing, and it should continue in this direction tomorrow!

We also took into account people saying the goal was hard to understand at first. A tutorial might see the day but not this week. Until then we tried to add a bit more element to understand quickly (and without too much read)

Balancing and targeting monsters rework

Pictures of delivery points added to "how to play" poster

Added light on objects not held in hands (to improve visibility when lost)

Fix: wall and door problem in pizzeria storeroom

Fix: egg spawning mid air or indoor bugs

Add attack animation when using Chorizo

Fix: Ghoul position after city shuffle

Balloon only spawn the first day

Fix: UI now affected by brightness

Monsters now attack when player is too close even if not targeted


And for what's to come soon (not exhaustive):
Add animations to the recap of the day, to make things clearer and more juicy,

Make Balloon moves slightly towards nearby players,

Prevent interaction through walls and obstacles,

Prevent dropping or throwing objects inside or behind walls and obstacles

Fix camera messy behavior when in spectator mode and object blurriness when moving



As always, thank you for your support and help !

See you soon (probably tomorrow!)!
